rules.rule: BINDING: preferred-frame coupling must be screened by e^-y (=1-mu); constant PF couplings are killed at G7 (AeST alpha_2~1/K_B; disformal ~phi_dot_c^2).
BINDING: PPN-visible screened coupling must NOT also control a propagating mode's kinetic normalization (P7: e^-y screening then => strong coupling; the khronometric wound).
BINDING: a lensing-cancelling carrier stress must be O(eps^2) matching Sigma_P; quadratic-flux carriers give O(eps^3+) and cannot cancel (T3 + order-counting kill).
BINDING: MOND sector must not weight the lapse (phi=ln N or N-weighted flux) -- demotes H_perp, +1 DOF + strong coupling (proven twice: lapse-tied and sf42).
BINDING: spatial inverse operators change momentum scaling, NEVER perturbative amplitude order (no eps^3->eps^2 rescue by Delta^-1).

BINDING: within local <=2-derivative single-metric class, correct MOND lensing REQUIRES an unremovable preferred-frame carrier (108k exhaustive search; unique lensing fix = Bekenstein disformal, cancellation ~A_0^2).
BINDING: mu(y)=1-e^-y frozen; never altered to rescue a candidate. G_eff/G_N=1 with no bare-G rescaling.
BINDING: screening is kernel-dependent -- exponential 1-e^-y screens alpha_2 by ~1e30000; power-law mu_n leaves alpha_2 ~7e-6 at Neptune (60x over).

BINDING: in a localized nonlocal-kernel theory, the operator that gaps the auxiliary mode must NOT be the operator that builds the MOND kernel — a shared mass has an empty window (DC-011); require scale-split/two-auxiliary structure.

BINDING: exact Coulomb kernel from local auxiliaries FORCES det(M)=0 -- the massless pole IS the kernel; never propose 'fully gapped' localizations (Thm A). Ghost-free scale-split skeleton exists (Thm B): gap only the non-kernel direction; source must couple ONLY to the massless direction.

BINDING: LOCALIZING a nonlocal kernel is NOT an escape from the pincer (DC-001) -- a localized theory IS local. A frameless local single-metric MOND theory under-lenses (massless carrier has zero linear stress; conformal fix cancels in Phi+Psi; only a timelike-gradient/frame sources Psi). Correct MOND lensing REQUIRES a preferred-frame carrier, full stop.

BINDING THEOREM (slip-lock, DC-013): a FRAME-FREE single-metric theory CANNOT give correct MOND lensing. Diff-invariance locks any extra mode's (Phi,Psi) coupling to the delta-R direction (1,-2), giving an f(R)-type slip eta!=1 whenever gravity is enhanced. Correct MOND lensing (eta=1 + enhancement) REQUIRES a preferred-frame carrier. Any number of modes / nonlocal form factors do not evade (same ray at every k).

BINDING: a stiff/non-propagating timelike preferred-frame vector CANNOT supply the DC-013 lensing slip for free -- its longitudinal mode is normalized by the screened mass (=> K~e^-y => P7 strong coupling) or by independent (div u)^2 stiffness (=> temporal ghost).
